spec.name: Shvetashvatara Upanishad
spec.description: The jewel of the Krishna Yajurveda synthesizing Sankhya cosmology, Ashtanga Yoga practice, personal devotion (Para-Bhakti) to Rudra, and non-dual Vedantic realization.

chapterNames.1: Adhyāya 1 — The Cosmic Inquiry: What is the Primordial Cause of the Universe?
chapterNames.2: Adhyāya 2 — The Discipline of Yoga & Discovery of the Inner Light
chapterNames.3: Adhyāya 3 — The Supreme Being Rudra & All-Pervading Cosmic Person
chapterNames.4: Adhyāya 4 — Prakriti, Purusha & The Two Birds in the Tree of Life
chapterNames.5: Adhyāya 5 — Vidya and Avidya, Microcosm and Macrocosm
chapterNames.6: Adhyāya 6 — The Sovereign Ruler of Nature, Supreme Devotion & Final Deliverance

authors.name: Ādi Śaṅkarācārya
authors.description: Classical commentary delineating the non-dual truth behind the apparent dualities of Nature and God.

authors.name: Vedic Theistic Synthesis
authors.description: Integration of deep devotional contemplation (Bhakti) with pristine Advaitic Self-inquiry.

rawVerses.original: ॐ ब्रह्मवादिनो वदन्ति । किं कारणं ब्रह्म कुतः स्म जाता जीवाम केन क्व च संप्रतिष्ठाः ॥ १ ॥
rawVerses.transliteration: om brahmavādino vadanti | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ brahma kutaḥ sma jātā jīvāma kena kva ca saṃpratiṣṭhāḥ || 1 ||
rawVerses.translation: The knowers of Brahman inquire: What is the primal cause? Is it Brahman? Whence are we born? By what do we live? And in what do we find our final rest?
rawVerses.meaning: The ultimate philosophical inquiry: setting aside mechanical and materialistic theories to probe the conscious ground of cosmic existence.

adi-shankara.en: [Adi Shankaracharya] Sages gather to investigate the root source of reality, rejecting unconscious time, nature, or chance as the ultimate cause.
adi-shankara.hi: [आदि शंकराचार्य] ब्रह्मवेत्ता ऋषि परम कारण की मीमांसा करते हैं और काल या स्वभाव जैसे जड़ कारणों को अस्वीकार कर चैतन्य ब्रह्म की खोज करते हैं।
adi-shankara.mr: [आद्य शंकराचार्य] विश्वाचे मूळ कारण काय आहे या गहन प्रश्नाचा शोध घेणारे हे श्लोक मानवी बुद्धीला अंतिम सत्याकडे वळवतात.

universal-synthesis.en: [Vedic Theistic Synthesis] The Upanishad begins by anchoring philosophical questioning in the highest yearning of the human spirit for its divine origin.
universal-synthesis.hi: [वैदिक समन्वय] जीवन का उद्गम और उसका चरम लक्ष्य केवल आत्मज्ञान में ही पूर्णता प्राप्त कर सकता है।
universal-synthesis.mr: [वैदिक समन्वय] आत्मज्ञानाशिवाय जीवनाच्या कोणत्याही कोड्याचे अंतिम उत्तर मिळू शकत नाही हेच उपनिषदांचे प्रतिपादन आहे.

rawVerses.original: ते ध्यानयोगानुगता अपश्यन् देवात्मशक्तिं स्वगुणैर्निगूढाम् । यः कारणानि निखिलानि तानि कालात्मयुक्तान्यधितिष्ठत्येकः ॥ २ ॥
rawVerses.transliteration: te dhyāna-yogānugatā apaśyan devātma-śaktiṃ svaguṇair-nigūḍhām | yaḥ kāraṇāni nikhilāni tāni kālātma-yuktāny-adhitiṣṭhaty-ekaḥ || 2 ||
rawVerses.translation: Entering into the absorption of deep meditation (Dhyana-Yoga), they discovered the mysterious divine power of God, concealed by its own qualities (Gunas), which alone rules all the causes from time to the soul.
rawVerses.meaning: Reasoning alone cannot pierce the cosmic mystery; it is through contemplative stillness that the divine creative power (Devatma-Shakti) is beheld.

adi-shankara.en: [Adi Shankaracharya] Through meditative absorption, the sages perceived Maya, the inexplicable divine potency of Brahman, veiling the truth through Sattva, Rajas, and Tamas.
adi-shankara.hi: [आदि शंकराचार्य] ध्यानयोग में लीन होकर ऋषियों ने परब्रह्म की उस त्रिगुणात्मिका शक्ति (माया) का साक्षात्कार किया जो सम्पूर्ण विश्व का संचालन करती है।
adi-shankara.mr: [आद्य शंकराचार्य] केवळ तर्काने नव्हे तर ध्यानयोगाच्या माध्यमातूनच विश्वाच्या गूढ दैवी शक्तीचे रहस्य साधकाला उलगडते.

universal-synthesis.en: [Vedic Theistic Synthesis] The bridge between Ashtanga Yoga and Vedantic metaphysics: direct empirical realization through contemplative stillness.
universal-synthesis.hi: [वैदिक समन्वय] योग साधना और आत्मज्ञान का यह संगम मानवीय चेतना को प्रत्यक्ष अनुभूति प्रदान करता है।
universal-synthesis.mr: [वैदिक समन्वय] ध्यानाच्या शांततेतच आत्मशक्तीचा प्रत्यक्ष साक्षात्कार घडून सर्व संशय कायमचे नाहीसे होतात.
